scripts.build: tsc && node -e "const fs = require('fs'); const path = require('path'); const src = path.join('src', 'sw'); const dest = path.join('dist', 'sw'); if (!fs.existsSync(dest)) fs.mkdirSync(dest, { recursive: true }); fs.copyFileSync(path.join(src, 'dices.json'), path.join(dest, 'dices.json')); fs.copyFileSync(path.join(src, 'result-texts.json'), path.join(dest, 'result-texts.json'));"
